title: Migrate miscellaneous export leaf records from TypedDict to dataclasses
description:
Replace the remaining standalone export leaf records in `schemas/game_export_types.py` with dataclasses: `Action`, `GameOver`, `Annotation`, `GameError`, and `CardMetadata`.

Keep this PR focused on those record types plus the direct helpers and tests that construct or consume them. Do not combine this with the root `GameExport` / `BuiltGameExport` migration.

This issue exists to clear the remaining leaf records before the final container migration.
